title: Tangy Tofu Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy German-inspired stir fry made with marinated tofu and a tangy sauce, served with a side of festive vegetables.

ingredients.name: tofu
ingredients.notes: marinated in a mixture of soy sauce and festive spices

ingredients.name: tangy sauce
ingredients.notes: made with soy sauce and festive spices

instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the tofu and cook until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the bell peppers and onions and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the ginger and garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the tangy sauce and stir to coat.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
